{{Quote|Hey, hey! One of the Meatlumps never made it out of the lower maintenance areas. I think he's trapped down there. Can you find him for me?|Decider Ximo Tacx, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtLM" />}}
'''Ximo Tacx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was a [[decider]] of the technology-hating Meatlumps and operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:RtLM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ximo Tacx tasked a spacer with rescuing a Meatlump trapped in the [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels#Lower Maintenance Areas|lower maintenance areas of Coronet's underground tunnels]]. The spacer descended into the lower maintenance areas and fought through hostile [[S-1 security droid|S-1]] and [[S-2 security droid]]s. The spacer eventually found the missing Meatlump, trapped by a band of ruffians from the rival [[Ragtags|Ragtag gang]]. The spacer killed the Ragtags and brought the Meatlump back to Ximo Tacx.<ref name="SWG:RtLM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ximo Tacx appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtLM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ximo Tacx was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
